name: Kyouison Girls
source:
A super short story about illness that just listens to the stories of inpatients (Menhera Girls) at the hospital.

All the characters appearing are "Menhera".

[Taken from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/4933]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
一个关于疾病的超短篇故事，只是听医院住院病人（Menhera Girls）的故事。

所有出现的角色都是“Menhera”。

[摘自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/4933]NovelGame[/url]]
